title: The Price of Compliance: emission-mask-constrained adversarial attacks on deep learning spectrum sensing in the 5.9 GHz ITS band (research framework)
description:
Complete Phase-1 research framework: post-FCC 5.9 GHz coexistence waveform generators (C-V2X PC5, 802.11p, U-NII-4 Wi-Fi), TR 37.885-inspired channels, a differentiable receiver front-end, the mask-constrained waveform-domain adversarial attack (the Compliant Attacker), mask-matched adversarial training defense, MEAP / Price-of-Compliance metrics, and the paper draft with its claim-verification matrix. All result JSONs embed configuration and seeds.

Wave 10-14 additions in this release: enforcement of the REAL regulatory limits (ETSI EN 302 571 Table-7 per-bin, its 1-MHz-RBW mean-power measurement domain, and the US 47 CFR 95.3205-shaped domain, all post-PA-verified at 0.00 dBr), attack-seed replication ({7,11,22} x 3 defense models with per-window capture), paired-bootstrap MEAP/PoC confidence intervals, a K-receiver cooperative-sensing fusion baseline (+25.3 dB detection gain, PoC unchanged), 5-seed Monte-Carlo harm-chain error bands, an 86-check independent audit script, and CI gates (MEAP recompute + red-team CLI smoke). Waves 6-9 additions previously: real over-the-air 802.11 captures (Fontaine/UGent, CC BY-NC-SA, data/real_wifi with ATTRIBUTION.md) as the WiFi class, a second victim architecture with surrogate-transfer evaluation, a 3-training-seed protocol, a TRADES defense ablation, and the one-command v2x-redteam evaluation CLI with in-run mask-physics gates. Code: MIT. Embedded real-capture data: CC BY-NC-SA.
